Be Careful about Cloning

谨慎看待克隆 · 213 词 · 3 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1After a series of initial experiments and corrections to his methods, the scientist’s hard work paid off when two cloned turkeys hatched with normal feathers and claws. The breakthrough raised hopes that people might someday have genetically similar copies of pets they had adored and lost. However, it bothered him from time to time that the turkeys were in poor health and were too weak to resist illness. This drawback cast him down. Merely two weeks later, the clones and an adult turkey involved in the experiment died, leaving him deeply discouraged. He retired before he attained his goal and became a member of an opera chorus to relieve his depression.

2Shortly afterwards, the media published a conservative opinion piece opposing cloning on moral grounds. It called for compulsory regulations that would forbid the use of cloning for commercial profit.

3When interviewed, the scientist stared at the decorations on the ceiling, thinking for a while, and then said, “I’m not in favour of any arbitrary assumption, but undertaking cloning is very different from the straightforward procedure of making loaves of bread from flour. Until we accumulate enough accurate knowledge, our efforts are likely to be in vain. Altogether, it is reasonable to be careful so that we don’t go down the wrong road.”

谨慎看待克隆

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1经过一系列初期试验和调整，科学家的努力终于有了回报。两只克隆火鸡孵化出来，羽毛和爪子看起来都很正常。这项突破让人们燃起希望，将来或许能得到与已经失去的爱宠基因相近的动物。可是，这两只火鸡体质很差，抵抗不住疾病，这让科学家时常烦恼。这个问题也让他深感沮丧。仅仅两个星期后，两只克隆火鸡和参与试验的一只成年火鸡都死了，他很受打击。他还没实现自己的目标就退休了，并加入歌剧合唱团来排解苦闷。

2没过多久，媒体刊出一篇出于道德考虑而反对克隆的保守评论。评论还建议制定有强制力的规定，禁止通过克隆谋取商业利润。

3接受采访时，科学家盯着天花板上的装饰想了一会儿，才说：“我不赞成随意作假设。做克隆和用面粉烤面包完全是两回事。在掌握足够准确的知识之前，贸然尝试会白费力气，也很可能失败。总的来说，还是谨慎一些好，免得走上岔路。”
